setup.title: Setup is not finished.
setup.description: Enter a model, its API key and the game paths to start translating.

no_session.title: Open this page from the x2loc program
no_session.description: This page is reached through the link x2loc opens when it starts. Run x2loc again to get a new one.

errors.app_unreachable: Cannot reach x2loc; the program may have been closed.
errors.unauthorized: The session has expired. Open this page from the x2loc program again.
errors.forbidden_host: The request came from an untrusted origin.
errors.internal_error: Internal error; see the log in the x2loc window.
errors.paths_not_set: The Workshop folder and the game's Mods folder are not set.
errors.mod_not_found: A selected mod is not in the Workshop folder.
errors.run_in_progress: A run is already in progress; wait for it to finish.
errors.job_not_found: No translation of this mod exists.
errors.unit_not_on_weblate: This string is not on Weblate and cannot be submitted there.
errors.weblate_forbidden: Weblate refused the operation; check the token's permissions
errors.llm_unauthorized: The model service rejected the API key
errors.llm_rejected: The model service returned an error
errors.mod_content_invalid: The mod's files cannot be parsed

sources.manual_hint: Translations you corrected on the Review page
sources.machine_hint: Translated here with your model and approved by the quality gate
sources.needs_editing_hint: Failed the quality gate and await a human check
sources.shipped_hint: Chinese the mod's author ships, never reviewed
sources.source_hint: Kept in English when none of the above exists; always last

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Model, Weblate and game paths. Secrets are kept in the Windows Credential Manager, never in the settings file.

secret.replace: Enter a new value to replace it

model.title: Translation model
model.description: Any OpenAI-compatible service, such as OpenRouter or a model running locally.
model.api_key_hint: Required. For a local model that does not check it, any text will do.
model.concurrency_hint: Most requests sent to the model service at once, shared by every mod of a run. Keep it below your provider's rate limit.
model.threshold_hint: Translations scored below it are marked as needing edits.
model.batch_size_hint: Strings taken per round; each round translates, validates, scores and writes them. Larger means fewer rounds, smaller means translations are written sooner.
model.units_per_request_hint: Strings packed into one model request. Larger means fewer requests, but each is longer and a failure retries more strings.

weblate.title: Weblate
weblate.description: The community translation memory. Without a token, existing translations are read and the rest is translated here.
weblate.token_hint: Optional. A token that can write lets you upload translations made here.
weblate.store_auto: Weblate when the token can write, otherwise this computer.
weblate.store_local: Always this computer; upload a selection later from Uploads.
weblate.store_weblate: Always straight to Weblate; needs a token that can write.

paths.title: Game paths
paths.description: The Workshop folder of your subscribed mods, and the game's Mods folder translations are installed into.
paths.not_found: XCOM 2 was not found in any Steam library.

priority.title: Translation priority
priority.description: When a string has several translations, the first in this order is used. Drag to reorder.

general.title: General
general.jobs_hint: Mods processed side by side. They share the model's request limit above, so raising this adds no load on the model service; it only spares small mods from waiting behind large ones.

mods.title: Mods
mods.description: Your subscribed Workshop mods and their progress on Weblate. Select mods to translate; finished translations are installed automatically.

coverage.failed: Reading progress from Weblate failed; it is not shown for now.

no_paths.title: Set the game paths first
no_paths.description: x2loc needs the Workshop folder of your subscribed mods and the game's Mods folder.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Each start of a translation is a run; every mod in it is translated and installed on its own.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.description: Select the mods to translate on the Mods page.

overlays.title: Installed translations
overlays.description: Translation mods x2loc installed into the game's Mods folder. They are separate from the original mods, so a mod update never overwrites them.

empty.title: No translations installed
empty.description: Translated mods are installed here automatically.

confirm.title: Uninstall this translation?
confirm.description: The translation mod folder of "{{title}}" will be deleted. Translations kept on this computer stay, so it can be rebuilt at any time.

review.title: Review
review.description: Translations that failed the quality gate. With write access, edits go straight to Weblate; otherwise they are kept here and queued for upload.

empty.title: Nothing to review
empty.description: Translations that fail the quality gate show up here.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.description: Translations kept on this computer and not yet on Weblate. Before uploading, each is checked against Weblate; strings someone else changed meanwhile become conflicts.
uploads.no_token: Uploading needs a Weblate token that can write.
uploads.conflicts_hint: Weblate's translation of these strings changed after they were translated here. Choose which one to keep.

empty.title: Nothing to upload
empty.description: Translations made or edited here show up here.
